subject: Shiny server doesn't check the server.R unless it has been modified

messages.author: d8c9efdc99bc34f0
messages.subject: Shiny server doesn't check the server.R unless it has been modified
parts:
Hi,

We have used shiny to make a kaggle-esque competition system for internal competitions. However we have  a small problem. A lot of internal competition occur and the competition information is taken from files within a directory structure. Shiny works very well, but the competition list won't update unless we 'touch server.R' once we've added a new competition. I think this is because shiny checks to see if server.R has been modified since the last page load and if so, re executes server.R. Is there a way to force shiny to always read server.R on page load and thus have a truly dynamic competition list without having to 'touch server.R'?

Cheers,

Morgan

messages.subject: Re: Shiny server doesn't check the server.R unless it has been modified
parts:
Put the calls that are reading the directories, from outside the shinyServer function, to inside the shinyServer function.

http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/scoping.html

You want per-session objects in this case.
